title: The Referee (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational soccer philosophy 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal absurdist sport football
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The referee is the only person on the pitch who cannot score
He runs the same distance as the players but gets nothing more
He is the only person present who everyone believes is wrong
And yet without him nothing is the game that we belong

[Pre-Chorus]
I have been the referee at various points in my career
By which I mean I've sat between two sons who couldn't hear each other

[Chorus]
The referee knows something I don't know
He knows the rules in situations where the rules don't quite go
The referee has given up the right to be supported
And chosen to be present in the middle unrewarded
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The crowd behind the goal sees everything with perfect clarity
The referee is standing fifteen metres from the parity
Between two versions of the same event at identical speed
And has to make a call in half a second guaranteed

[Bridge]
Nobody thanks the referee when the match is even and clean
Nobody mentions the referee in the report of the scene
He appears in the story only when the story goes wrong
The referee's the one who keeps the whole thing going along

[Outro]
Referee knows… the rules live in a man running… referee knows
That's my boy
